name: Curl Noise Generation
aliases: Divergence-free vector field from noise derivatives
definition: A divergence-free vector field generated from noise derivatives, used to create smooth flow effects for particles. In this implementation, it is a 2D curl texture derived from a 2D input texture.
summary: Curl noise generation produces divergence-free vector fields from scalar noise derivatives, offering a computationally cheaper alternative to fluid simulation for organic flow patterns.
